benchmarks.label: No reference
benchmarks.description: Show the selected places on their own.

benchmarks.label: New York City (all five boroughs)
benchmarks.description: Built by adding the five boroughs' underlying counts and recomputing the measure from the totals. New York City is exactly these five counties, whatever else is in view.

benchmarks.label: New York State (published state figure)
benchmarks.description: The state's own row in the same release, read as published. It is not built by adding or averaging counties.

benchmarks.label: The selected places combined
benchmarks.description: Built by adding the selected places' underlying counts and recomputing the measure from the totals.
benchmarks.unavailable_reason: A reference built from the places you selected has to be recomputed from the underlying counts for each combination, which needs the local service. New York City, New York State and each county are available here because each is one fixed set of areas, computed during the build.
